messages:
Alice (Partners): Quick huddle — final orchestration for Marketplace launch next week. Need to confirm: marketplace listing embargo, HW partner cert slot times, SI dry-run schedule, and blog/press publish gates.
Clara (Mktg): PR/Blog plan: draft blog ready, press embargo window we want is Tue 09:00 PT. Need legal + product quote by Mon EOD. Design needs final hero (2 variants) by Mon noon.
Devin (Legal): On embargo: we can do Tue 09:00 PT. Two legal notes: (1) no customer logos in the initial wave, (2) hw partner logos require partner-signed usage form. I'll upload the form to the shared drive.
Evan (SI): Dry-run: propose Wed 14:00 PT for SI integration dress rehearsal (30m). Need partner engineers added to staging org and a scoped token with deployment perms. Also, we'll run the sample workload from the onboarding guide.
Ben (Eng): Staging org link: https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/marketplace (internal). Token creation example below — use the partner-qa cluster:
```
POST /v1/partner_tokens
{
  "env":"partner-qa",
  "scopes":["models:read","deploy:create","logs:read"],
  "ttl_seconds":86400
}
```
Alice (Partners): Nice. @Ben (Eng) can you also attach a short perf snapshot for the sample workload (p99 lat, throughput at batch=8) so SI can tune?
Ben (Eng): Will do. I can share a single-slide perf summary by tomorrow morning.
Clara (Mktg): Landing page: A/B test hero variant A (technical) vs B (business). We need copyboiler and final images. Also confirm CDN purge window after deploy — prefer immediate once catalog goes live.
Devin (Legal): For quotes: please avoid feature-level commitments. I can approve short attribution lines. Send drafts to me.
Evan (SI): Also request: a tiny troubleshooting checklist (auth errors, quota hits, common 403/429 fixes) for partner SIs. That’ll save time during the dry-run.
Alice (Partners): Action list: 1) @Devin Legal — upload logo usage form + embargo ok (Mon AM). 2) @Ben Eng — perf snapshot + token script (tomorrow). 3) @Evan SI — draft SI checklist + confirm dry-run attendees (today). 4) @Clara Mktg — blog + quote drafts + hero variants (Mon noon). 5) I'll coordinate HW partner cert slots and share calendar invites.
ReleaseBot: Deploy scheduled: marketplace-catalog v1.2 -> staging at 2024-07-08T03:30Z. Monitor #release-war-room for logs.
Alice (Partners): Any last blockers? If none, I’ll compile the partner playbook draft and ship to the partner mailing list by EOD today. :rocket:
